dslRule:
<!id: add-null-check-for-list-access>
<!description: Adds a null check for a list expression before accessing its size and first element to prevent NullPointerException.>
<!severity: WARNING>

$list.size() > 0 && $list.get(0) instanceof $type :: instanceof($list, "java.util.List")
=>
$list != null && $list.size() > 0 && $list.get(0) instanceof $type
;;
summary: Adds a null check to a list expression that is checked for size > 0 and element type to prevent NPE.
